items.text: The Pradhan Mantri Virasat Ka Samvardhan (PM VIKAS) is a Central Sector Scheme of the Ministry of Minority Affairs which converges five erstwhile schemes viz. ‘Seekho Aur Kamao’, ‘Nai Manzil’, ‘Nai Roshni’ and ‘USTTAD’ & ‘Hamari Dharohar’ schemes and focuses on socio-economic empowerment of six notified minority communities (Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains, and Parsis) through the following:
i.	Skilling and Training (Non-traditional and traditional)
ii.	Women Leadership and Entrepreneurship
iii.	Education (through National Institute of Open Schooling)
iv.	Infrastructure Development (through Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram)
Scheme Objectives:

The initiative aims to empower minority communities through targeted skill training, formal education via open schooling, and improved livelihood opportunities. It promotes the preservation cultural heritage and traditional arts and crafts. Women from minority communities are empowered through leadership and entrepreneurship support. Market and credit linkages are provided to enhance employability and enterprise.
Salient Features:
items.heading: Salient Features:

items.text: 1)	Aims at holistic development of minority communities through skilling, education, entrepreneurship, and cultural heritage preservation.
items.heading: Salient Features:

items.text: 2)	Merges five earlier schemes: Seekho aur Kamao, USTTAD, Hamari Dharohar, Nai Roshni, and Nai Manzil.
items.heading: Salient Features:

items.text: 3)	Focuses on traditional and modern skill training, women’s leadership, education for school dropouts, and infrastructure development.
items.heading: Salient Features:

items.text: 4)	Special emphasis on women, youth, and persons with disabilities from six notified minority communities.
items.heading: Salient Features:

items.text: 5)	Provides financial support, market linkages, and credit access through convergence with other government schemes.
items.heading: Salient Features:

items.text: 6)	100% central funding for training, education, and entrepreneurship; infrastructure support via Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram (PMJVK) on a cost-sharing basis.
items.heading: Salient Features:

items.text: Target Beneficiaries:
items.heading: Target Beneficiaries:

items.text: 1)	Indian nationals belonging to the six notified minority communities: Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains, and Parsis with following:
items.heading: Target Beneficiaries:

items.text: a.	Minority individuals aged 14–45 years for skilling and education; 18–45 years for women leadership and entrepreneurship.
items.heading: Target Beneficiaries:

items.text: b.	Women beneficiaries: Minimum 33% in skilling, 50% in education, and 100% in women leadership and entrepreneurship component.
items.heading: Target Beneficiaries:

items.text: c.	Persons with Disabilities (PwDs): 3% reservation across all components.
items.heading: Target Beneficiaries:

items.text: 2)	Up to 25% non-minority (EWS) candidates may be included in Traditional Skilling and 15% in other components to promote inter-community solidarity.
items.heading: Target Beneficiaries:

items.text: Benefits:
items.heading: Benefits:

items.text: 1)	Provides skill development in both traditional crafts and modern sectors to enhance employability of minority youth.
items.heading: Benefits:

items.text: 2)	Empowers minority women through leadership and entrepreneurship training, including support to start enterprises.
items.heading: Benefits:

items.text: 3)	Offers bridge education for school dropouts to complete classes 8th, 10th, and 12th via open schooling.
items.heading: Benefits:

items.text: 4)	Facilitates access to credit, market linkages, and e-commerce platforms for artisans and entrepreneurs.
items.heading: Benefits:

items.text: 5)	Promotes preservation and promotion of traditional arts, crafts, and cultural heritage.
items.heading: Benefits:

items.text: 6)	Ensures inclusive development by converging with other government schemes and leveraging existing infrastructure.
items.heading: Benefits:

items.text: 1)	Skill training (both traditional and modern)
2)	Education support (8th std, 10th std. and 12th std.)
3)	Leadership and entrepreneurship support for women
4)	Stipend support to trainees
1)	The Age of the applicant should be 14 to 45 years for skilling and education component and 18 to 45 years for Women Leadership and Entrepreneurship Component
2)	33% of total seats in Skilling and Training component, 50% of total seats in Education component and 100% of total seats in Women Leadership and Entrepreneurship component are earmarked for women.

3)	The education qualification for Skilling and Training component would be as per NSQF norms and Education component would be as per NIOS norms. Candidates with aptitude and leadership qualities will be selected for Women Leadership and Entrepreneurship component.
Step 01: Register/Login
Visit the SIDH Portal (https://www.skillindiadigital.gov.in/), register as a Learner/Participant (Candidate) or log in if already registered, and complete e-KYC using your personal details.
Step 02:Profile Setup
items.heading: Step 02:Profile Setup

items.text: Create your account password/PIN, verify your mobile number via OTP, and ensure all profile details (name, date of birth, and contact information) are accurate and updated.
items.heading: Step 02:Profile Setup

items.text: Step 03:Explore Schemes & Courses
items.heading: Step 03:Explore Schemes & Courses

items.text: Access your dashboard and search for PM VIKAS and job roles. Use filters such as scheme, mode, and sector to find suitable courses or batches.
items.heading: Step 03:Explore Schemes & Courses

items.text: Step 04:Show Interest / Apply for a Batch
items.heading: Step 04:Show Interest / Apply for a Batch

items.text: Choose a batch for your preferred job role and submit your interest or application. You may select up to five batches, which will be reviewed by the training partner /training centre.
items.heading: Step 04:Show Interest / Apply for a Batch

items.text: Step 05:Finalise Enrolment & Status
items.heading: Step 04:Show Interest / Apply for a Batch

items.text: After approval from the training partner / training centre, accept the invitation through your portal to confirm enrolment. Track your application status under the “Applications” section.
items.heading: Step 04:Show Interest / Apply for a Batch

2)	EWS Certificate for non-minority candidates.
